title: Sarvestan Palace
geometryBasis: Current four-corner outline for WHC component 1568-008 controls the footprint, with the mapped line length and angle kept. Archaeological sections and written dimensions distinguish the central iwan, domed rooms and arcades.
sectionBasis: The 2011 public-domain Qualla original records the fractured entry crown, missing parts of the iwans and pitted brick dome. Text in Bier’s measured survey and subsequent excavations fixes room order and measured widths.
limitations: The model represents the standing and restored ruin with exposed masonry, no theoretical original roof reconstruction.
Roof and wall losses, decayed ornament, secondary room dividers, roof profiles and elevations are approximate. Modern maintenance equipment and visitor infrastructure are excluded.
Original terrain stays unchanged and fixes approximate grade, not survey thresholds.
